## Active

### D-140 — The cli demo realm is hand-written and appended last in rush.json

> _2026-09-12 · demo/blong-cli · active_

The new project was APPENDED to the end of the `projects` array rather than inserted next to the
other demo packages, because Playwright ports are derived from each package's index there and
inserting would have shifted every later package's port. The demo realm `text` is hand-written
rather than scaffolded from `blong-kopi`: the realm skill says to scaffold, but kopi produces a
DB-backed CRUD realm with models, Playwright and a datastore, which is the opposite of what a `cli`
demo should be — a deliberate departure, recorded so it is not read as an oversight. The realm
folder needs its own `package.json` because the loader imports `./package.json` beside a realm's
`server.ts`, which is also why `demo/blong-eip/eip/package.json` exists. `textInput` throws a plain
`Error` for a missing input instead of an error-layer definition and the realm name is hardcoded in
`bin/blong-cli.ts`; both are deliberate minimalism in a demo, since a real command-driven realm
should define the error and take the realm from config. The demo has no `index.ts` and no
`server.ts` either: a command has nothing to serve, and `cli.ts` is the whole suite.
